business_summary: JN Group Inc. operates metaverse digital content, IoT solutions, and crypto asset and blockchain business in Japan, Hong Kong, and internationally. It engages in the planning, development, and sale of nursing care and AI robots; and agricultural ICT business. The company primarily focus on metaverse and digital content, including electronic registry business development; sales and marketing of computer software Information gathering on services and situations in the metaverse field development; and operation of commission platforms and web services. It also provides IOT solution, a system with various objects connected to a network exchange information with each other and perform various controls automatically; involved in cryptocurrency and blockchain business; data communication, M2M, and AI products; fleet management solutions, including acquires and manages vehicle information in real time; contract development and services, such as system development, developing support and consulting, various drivers and software development, localization of overseas products, examination, certification, and testing agency, and onsite and send back maintenance. In addition, it supplies, total solutions to logistics and restaurant chains; content production and support for virtual spaces and digital content comprising e-books, and other digital content; plans, produces, and sells various packages and promotional tools to retail chains such as cosmetic shops. Additionally, it engages in the wholesaling and retailing of food products; import and export of daily necessities; sales of miscellaneous goods; travelling related services; plan and implement corporate communication strategies; and consulting and engineering services. The company also offers a cryptocurrency exchange platform. The company was formerly known as NCXX Group Inc. and change its name to JN Group Inc. in March 2026. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Hanamaki, Japan.
